index.title: Getting Started
index.summary: Automatic WordPress Admin installation, manual ZIP upload, and FTP setup procedures.
index.content: Install Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker via the WordPress Admin plugin directory by searching for 'Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker' or by uploading the downloadable ZIP archive under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin. For FTP installations, extract the archive to /wp-content/plugins/smart-affiliate-link-cloaker/ and activate through the administration panel.

index.title: Activating Pro
index.summary: Entering and validating Freemius software license keys inside wp-admin.
index.content: To activate Pro features, navigate to Link Cloaker > Account in your WordPress admin menu. Paste your license key generated upon Freemius checkout. The engine validates the key via secure REST API handshake and unlocks advanced modules instantly.

index.title: Configuration Guide
index.summary: Setting default 301 or 307 HTTP status codes and choosing global FTC disclosure placement.
index.content: Under Link Cloaker > Settings, select your default HTTP redirection header (301 Permanent Redirect for SEO pass-through or 307 Temporary Redirect for dynamic tracking). Configure FTC auto-disclosure rules by selecting global placement: Top of Content, Bottom of Content, or Immediately Preceding First Commercial Link.

index.title: Advanced Modules
index.summary: Configuring Cloudflare IP country headers for geolocation, setting up A/B split traffic percentages, and tuning keyword auto-linker thresholds.
index.content: Enable Geo-Routing in link settings to utilize Cloudflare IP country headers or MaxMind local databases. Set up A/B Split Testing by providing multiple target URLs with percentage weights (e.g. 50/50 split). Configure DOM Keyword Auto-Linker thresholds to automatically convert target keywords into cloaked links while protecting headings, existing anchors, and code blocks.

index.title: Privacy & Security
index.summary: Cookie-less execution details, PII-free data policies, and GDPR compliance validation.
index.content: Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker uses a 100% cookie-less redirect execution engine. Click statistics are logged anonymously without storing IP addresses or Personally Identifiable Information (PII), ensuring strict compliance with GDPR and global privacy standards.

index.title: System Setup
index.summary: Installing native binaries on Windows, macOS, or Linux operating system.
index.content: Download the native binary matching your operating system: Windows (.msi/.exe installer), macOS (.dmg package), or Linux (.deb/.AppImage). Run the installer to unpack the binary. No third-party runtime frameworks (such as Node.js or Java) are required.

index.title: Database Initialization
index.summary: Automatic local SQLite migration and Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) data safety.
index.content: Upon initial launch, ShelfMaster creates an ACID-compliant local SQLite3 database stored in your user application data directory. Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode is auto-configured to ensure transactional integrity during unexpected power loss.

index.title: Peripherals Integration
index.summary: Configuring USB plug-and-play barcode scanners and setting up 58mm/80mm thermal receipt printers.
index.content: Connect standard USB HID barcode scanners directly—no drivers needed. Under Settings > Peripherals, select your receipt printer paper width (58mm or 80mm ESC/POS) or standard A4 printer to enable instant POS checkouts and certificate printing.

index.title: Financial Workflows
index.summary: Generating monthly payroll, processing itemized expense vouchers, and running end-of-year audit reports.
index.content: Manage institutional finances using the built-in ledger modules. Record daily operational expense vouchers, process staff salary pay-slips with deduction calculations, and export unified cash-flow audit reports.

index.title: Backup & Recovery
index.summary: Generating encrypted local backup archives and executing one-click database restorations.
index.content: Execute one-click database backups under Settings > Backup & Data Safety. The system exports an encrypted SQLite archive snapshot that can be transferred or restored to any machine running ShelfMaster.
